initialize_megatron_setup: initialize Megatron-LM distributed training setup with accelerator and optional extra arguments
build_megatron_engine: build a MegatronEngine wrapper that manages model, optimizer, scheduler, and training loop for Megatron-LM
prepare_model_optimizer_scheduler: prepare and configure a Megatron-LM model, optimizer, and learning rate scheduler with the accelerator
run_megatron_train_eval_step: run a Megatron-LM training or evaluation step with batch data, micro-batching, and pipeline parallelism
save_megatron_checkpoint: save or load a Megatron-LM training checkpoint including iteration, optimizer state, and floating point operation count
